Jordan / Ava —

Following up with technical specifics you can include in the RFI:

TAM coverage (summary):
- Hosted (self-serve + managed API): Business hours support (M–F 6am–6pm PT) with 24/7 escalation routing available for customers on Enterprise plan. Named TAM optional for enterprise.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity / Dedicated clusters): Named TAM included; 24x7 on-call rotation with primary/secondary escalation.

Escalation path (P0/P1):
- P0 (Production outage / data loss risk):
  - Acknowledge: 15–30 mins
  - Primary response (triage & fix): 1 hour SLA target
  - Escalation: TAM -> Support SRE -> Engineering on-call -> Exec on-call (if incident extends >4 hours)
- P1 (Severe degradation): acknowledge 30–60 mins; target mitigation in 4 hours.

Incident comms cadence (recommended template):
- T+0: Acknowledgement + initial severity and ETA for next update.
- T+1: Summary of triage, impacted customers, immediate mitigations.
- T+4: Status update with actions and ETA for resolution or next check-in.
- Post-mortem: delivered within 72 hours as an interim report; full RCA within 10 business days for P0.

Notes on maintenance windows & change controls: major upgrades are scheduled with a 2-week notice and a predefined maintenance window; High-impact changes for Dedicated customers can be islanded and scheduled outside business hours where required.

I can convert the above into a short runbook and escalation matrix spreadsheet.

—Karthik

Quick add for procurement language:

- SLA credits: For Hosted API customers we offer tiered service credits tied to monthly availability thresholds (examples: >99.9% availability — no credits; 99.5–99.9% — 10% credit; <99.5% — 25% credit). Dedicated customers can negotiate higher SLOs and credit terms in contract.
- Escalation execs: for customers under an enterprise MSA, exception handling (e.g., cross-team war rooms) is covered and we include an escalation path to VP-level support for extended incidents.
- Pricing/ops: named TAM hours are included in Dedicated annual contracts; additional retainer hours can be purchased for onboarding and runbook customization.

Also noting deal id HZ-3421 for the procurement paperwork. I'm happy to draft the procurement-friendly language and include it in the RFI response packet.
